title: What are you setting up?
desc: Take the shortest path to the workspace you need. Detailed review happens after setup.

title: Continue your setup
desc: Saved records and unfinished tasks are shown separately. Resume without starting over.

title: Identify your provider
desc: Capture the organization operating the service and the contact who maintains its records.

title: Confirm provider access
desc: Review the authorized administrator and the person responsible for security review.

title: Add your first service offering
desc: Give Mission Owners a clear service identity. Review its authorization and implementations later.

title: Add source material
desc: Optional: retain the package now and review its proposed records in the provider portal.

title: Check the package receipt
desc: The upload response was interrupted. Confirm the existing request before trying again.

title: Review provider setup
desc: Confirm the workspace details. Source review and service publication remain separate tasks.

title: Your provider workspace is ready
desc: Continue the detailed work in the portal, where the team can review it together.

title: Set up an organization
desc: Create the organization record and identify the person responsible for its administration.

title: Choose the organization administrator
desc: Use an existing authorized identity or find the person in the connected directory.

title: Directory lookup is unavailable
desc: Choose a supported path without losing the setup details already entered.

title: Review organization setup
desc: Confirm what will be created and what access will be established.

title: Organization setup status
desc: See what is ready and the next action appropriate to your access.

title: Review administrator setup status
desc: Reconcile an interrupted enrollment against the organization’s actual current access records.

title: Start your system workspace
desc: Capture the system identity and choose the documentation work you need to begin.

title: Identify your system team
desc: Review effective roles and assign the next preparation tasks without recreating organization membership.

title: Bring existing documentation
desc: Optional: add supported sources or start with a blank draft. Imports remain reviewable.

title: Identify how the system is hosted
desc: Associate the exact available service scope, or leave a clear task for later.

title: Plan cloud monitoring
desc: Optional: configure a permitted read-only connection now or continue without live monitoring.

title: Review system setup
desc: Create the workspace and a focused work queue for documentation and monitoring.

title: Your system workspace is ready
desc: Begin with the next useful task. The same records will build your package and support ongoing review.
